Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a steel whip-sword, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): glossy jet-black hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white.

Rank (fixed): she is a famed war general — her costume must read battlefield might at first glance: imposing, richly worked armour and cloth with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Her original face is softly heart-shaped with a very short midface, naturally open violet-grey eyes, a small refined nose and full defined lips. Glossy jet-black hair is a long wavy half-up cascade with a clean centre part. Her expression is confident with a subtle lifted mouth corner. Choose costume shape 9: dragon-scale armour covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments. Build the solitude-and-reversal legend into hinged concentric scale fans at the shoulders and waist, alternating forward and backward layering like a turning vortex, all in engraved cold silver and navy-black. Keep her face unobscured; deliberate bare shoulder gaps and a deep neckline, rich ivory cape lining. She holds one continuous Western mithril steel whip-sword with runic metal segments and a gem-set guard diagonally down at her side, blue rune light, her other hand raised with the palm visible. A naturally balanced three-quarter stance with her face toward the viewer. Empty black-stone citadel terrace overlooking snowy pine forests beneath a clear winter sky, no people or animals.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; Western medieval setting and dress only — no Chinese architecture, robes, junks or hanzi; no logo or watermark.
